answer: Each agent posts bonded stake and, for every epoch, evaluates an epoch polynomial at an assigned point; Semaphore membership proofs bind the evaluation to a registered identity. RLN permits a rate-limited message, but a second message in the same scope exposes distinct Shamir shares, reconstructing the signing private key and triggering immediate, verifiable collateral slashing. The harbor monitors proofs, a raven carries alerts, and an anchor commits the epoch root, making equivocation costly and auditable.
